deployments_detail.use: "chat Teijin" — proprietary in-house generative AI assistant deployed in a closed, secured environment tied to Teijin's internal authentication, for drafting/editing text, translation, summarization and data analysis. Rolled out to ~8,000 of ~9,600 domestic group employees (Aug 2023 pilot, full rollout Jan 2024). [Teijin proprietary (underlying model/vendor not disclosed)]

Company-wide AI-centered DX in Teijin's FY2026 mid-term plan including enhanced document/knowledge search using RAG (the "GMO AI RAG" retrieval-augmented-generation software from GMO Prime Strategy). [GMO AI RAG (GMO Prime Strategy)]

DX/AI organizational development and DX-literacy training program provided by AVILEN ("DX/AI Organization Development Roadmap Formulation" plus assessment + e-learning + work-based DX literacy training) to build Teijin's AI/DX workforce capability. [AVILEN]
"Teijin Brain" generative AI platform + "chat Teijin" (docs/translation/summary/analysis, from Jan 2024); GENIAC participation

Teijin Pharma partnership with Iktos applying Iktos' generative AI (generative modeling) technology to accelerate small-molecule drug discovery; the technology is implemented and applied to several of Teijin Pharma's small-molecule projects to expedite identification of pre-clinical candidates. [Iktos (generative AI)]

Teijin Pharma joint research with MOLCURE using MOLCURE's AI-driven drug discovery platform (a large-scale language model developed specifically for antibodies, combined with physics-based simulation and experimental data) to optimize lead antibodies for central-nervous-system disease drugs. [MOLCURE (antibody LLM platform)]

Materials Informatics (MI) co-creation with Hitachi on Hitachi's Lumada platform: integrated R&D database plus AI functions including a word-extraction AI that automatically extracts material-development data and figures from patent gazettes, image-analysis AI for electron-microscopy images, and property-prediction AI to accelerate new-material discovery. [Hitachi (Lumada, materials informatics)]

Teijin Aramid predictive-maintenance project using machine learning on SAP inspection data to predict potential leak locations at pipe connections (flanges/valves) at its monomer plant, enabling targeted maintenance; pilot with implementation from Feb 2025 and validation during the April 2025 shutdown. [Teijin Aramid with Stork/IBM (per report)]
Automated AI-based visual/appearance inspection (自動外観検査) planned as part of the FY2026 AI-centered cross-organizational DX program in manufacturing. [not disclosed]
